ticket_text: I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Please refund the extra charge.
reference_response: We apologize for the duplicate charge. We've initiated a refund that will appear in 3-5 business days.

ticket_text: How do I reset my password? I forgot it and can't log in.
reference_response: You can reset your password by clicking 'Forgot Password' on the login page. A reset link will be sent to your registered email.

ticket_text: Your product is absolute garbage. I'm contacting my lawyer if this isn't resolved TODAY.
Would be great if you could add dark mode to the mobile app.
reference_response: Thank you for the suggestion! We've logged this as a feature request and our product team will review it.

ticket_text: My dashboard has been showing a loading error for 3 days. Nothing works.
reference_response: We're sorry about the dashboard issue. Our team has identified the problem and a fix is being deployed. Please try clearing your browser cache and refreshing.
